reason: All six linux-riscv64 CI jobs fail with a conda solver error: "No candidates were found for cross-python_linux-riscv64 *". This is a missing dependency in the conda-forge channel, not a build or code issue in the feedstock itself. All other platforms (linux-64, linux-aarch64, linux-ppc64le, osx-64, osx-arm64, win-64) pass cleanly.
